text:
High: none in the embedded bytes. The prior B02 head-custody conflict is closed in this text. Five medium defects remain. Mapping A stays a specified-only proposal. W-D2, W-D3, B01–B17, and Sprint 1 remain open.

## Evidence limits

This pass read only the embedded manifest bytes. SHA-256 values, git HEAD `983a4bb49e3ccae399ee2514da2f6fa3f03593fd`, CLI status, graphify, and `history/pre-grok-repair-01/` were not recomputed or opened. No parser, codec, registry, verifier, consumer, or G01–G48 case was executed. A second provider review was not run in this turn.

Source/6, Core/5, the Source wrapper, wire `/3`, effect `/1`, and the six W-D2E positives support the packet’s observations: agreement `programId` and Core `programId` are different roles; the lowerer copies `selected.actionId` into Core `programId`; stage and episode exist only on the wire; effect images omit agreement, stage, episode, action, and Core-program ids; all six positives use `actionId=Action`. `SOURCE6_PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED` is the parser code for a wrong selected builtin. Those modules authenticate nothing.

## Prior high

Head custody now matches the W-D2F tag18 order. B02 retains an episode association and a stage-association reference. It does not compare `preHead`. Tag18 compares `wire.preHead` to `AST.intent.preHead`, then `AST.authenticated.head`, then authenticates B11, including registry-view and stage-association linkage, then compares B11’s authentic head to the signed preHead.

G12, G30, and G46–G48 keep the four results apart: missing linkage is `Unavailable/B11`; B02 proof content that misses its declared anchor is `EvidenceInvalid/B02`; a snapshot or linkage proof that misses its declared B11 fact is `EvidenceInvalid/B11`; a complete genuine other-head fact is `FieldMismatch/preHead`. Equal local heads do not establish stage linkage (G48). That removes the old second head authority.

The forward, membership, image, and positive controls requested last time are present as specified text: G32–G36, G37, G38–G40, G41, and G21. They were not run.

## What the proposal holds

Five nominal sorts are `AgreementInstanceId`, `StageId`, `EpisodeId`, `ActionId`, and `CoreProgramId`. Domain stays the existing carrier. The wrapper is `{stageId, episodeId}` around an unchanged Source AST and Core input. Missing slots stay missing through M. Constructors use the W-D2F subtype `[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}` with Source reserved words excluded.

Mapping A keeps the W-D2F action literal and the closed builtins. The S0 triples are `(TransferLiteralFee, TransferLiteralFee, transfer)` and `(RepayAccrualFirst, RepayAccrualFirst, repayment)`. Cross-sort spelling is not registration (G03). Mapping B is correctly fenced off: a logical alias needs a successor to the tag6 literal, so fixture `Action` cannot adopt B.

The numbered table is G01–G48. G21 is the only numbered non-rejection. The other 47 are rejection or control rows. G01 stops at unavailable B01. The multi-defect paragraphs follow W-D2F order for D-before-M, literal-before-binding, tag6-before-tag10, and tag8-before-tag10 (G16, G18, G24, G29, G31).

Wire `/3` and effect `/1` bytes, Source/6 grammar, and Core/5 preparation stay unchanged. The six equality fixtures stay equality fixtures. Questions 1–7 stay open: registry authority and view selection, episode genesis and concurrency, B05–B07 images and the source-hash self-reference, template versus instance, replay `(domain, signer, nonce)`, effect-schema identity, and any adopted vote.

## Medium defects

**M1. Wire stage/episode domain failures use a different path channel than W-D2F.** FIELD-MAP assigns a wire-only subtype failure `sourcePath=null` and `inputPath=wire.field`. The identity SPEC says a decoded wire identifier reports `sourcePath=wire.stageId` or `wire.episodeId`. G45 states that for context `Stage1` and wire `Stage/1`. G24 is that same mutation and omits `sourcePath`. The reject family and field name agree; the path record does not. Wrapper paths `context.stageId` and `context.episodeId` are a real new input. The wire channel already had a parent rule.

**M2. G21’s non-rejection covers tags that the same packet says are unreachable.** SPEC says a tag10 result is reachable only after tag8 B05 and every earlier gate have passed. B01’s declared forward comparisons are tags 4, 5, 6, 10, and 16. G21 says those forward comparisons do not reject, and that B05–B16 and B11 linkage are not discharged. Tags 4–6 can sit inside an isolated B01–B04 fragment. Tag10 cannot, and tag16 is behind B05, B06, B07, B08, B09, and B10 (G35, G36). One “do not reject” bundles a reachable fragment and an unreachable one. The isolated-label sentence does not split them.

**M3. Tag10’s comparison list omits the B01 association G35 requires.** The procedural sentence is: signed `coreProgramId`, then Source selection, then lowered `programId`, then B04’s expected `CoreProgramId` and builtin selector. G35 inserts B01’s `coreProgramIds` after the lowered literal and before B04’s target. The general retained-fact paragraph also requires that comparison. Read as a complete chain, the procedural sentence drops a check that false-accepts a genuine B04 target the agreement record did not declare. The same compression appears at tag6 against G34; the general rule covers it only when that rule wins over the enumerated chain. The packet never states that precedence.

**M4. B01 association comparison is unspecified for any list other than a failing singleton.** B03 says membership of the already authenticated stage occurrence (G37). B01 says only “compare” the retained stage, episode, action, Core-program, and asset associations. G32–G36 use lists that omit the current id. The baseline lists are singletons. Membership and exact set equality both reject those rows. They disagree when a B01 record lists both S0 actions, or more than the current stage. Exact equality false-rejects that agreement on the action that is present. The structural repay paragraph assumes a registration can permit the second triple, without an exact B01 list.

**M5. Two result families still fit one association disagreement, and two required comparisons have no row.** The diagnostic bullet sends a “conflicting relation” to `EvidenceInvalid`. G32–G36 send a genuine later anchor that disagrees with a genuine B01 association to `FieldMismatch` after that anchor authenticates. Both readings fit the unqualified bullet. Separately, B02’s retained episode association is required at tag5 and ordered after B01 by G33, but no row makes that association the first mismatch. G28 fails on the wrapper literal first. The repay identity control in the structural section has no number, no full projection, and no single expected outcome. G38–G40 each add a second, unnumbered hash-mismatch outcome beside the wrong-image mutation.

## Reading

The repair text does what the prior high and the missing-control list asked: B11 owns the head, B02 keeps an anchor reference, and the new rows separate unavailable, invalid, and mismatch for linkage, images, membership, and incompatible authentic targets. The remaining mediums are schedule and oracle contradictions inside that repair. They are specified-only. They authorize no registry, no verifier, and no gate closure.
